design.name: 熔心魔将
design.role: 3-3 铸范大坊领主（Unity 资产 SK_Boss_Warlord）；熔心大剑另建 SM_BossWeapon_Greatsword（inferno_boss_warlord_sword）
design.brief: A fully armoured demon swordsman general about 4.2 m tall, cast from dark violet basalt and burnished copper in the fire god Zhurong's foundry: heroic swordsman proportions (broad shoulders, V-shaped torso, narrower armoured waist, wide fencing stance), ancient Chinese general's lamellar armour covering about 80% of the body, tiered pauldrons with copper beast-head guards, a cracked round copper heart-mirror over a glowing furnace heart, a long segmented tasset skirt, horned helm with copper crescent horns framing a demon face; swordsman elements: colossal two-handed greatsword, basalt-and-copper scabbard on the back, crimson sword knot and tassel, crimson waist sash with trailing ribbons, cloth-wrapped grips, sword belt with copper fittings. Palette: dark violet basalt ~60%, burnished copper ~25%, crimson cloth and molten orange as accents.
design.style_note: Gunfire Reborn-style stylized boss sheet: chunky readable silhouette, big simplified bevelled planes, two or three dominant colour blocks, soft hand-painted gradients, low detail density; not realistic, not mecha, no dense tiny cracks or fine noise.
design.note: 2026-11-03 用户看了 v005（魔面 + 熔岩躯体）后说「相比之下我还是更喜欢铠甲多一些、剑士元素多一些的」，按这句写了 v006 提示词。当时在旧账号出过 4 张但页面没加载出来、没给用户看过，旧号任务现在拿不到；11-06 在新账号图片页用同一提示词重出 4 张。用户还没选，不建模。四选一拼图 docs/art/review/warlord-remodel/concept-v006-4options.jpg

generation.note: 图片页出图免费（Free 额度）。四张都是全身重甲剑士：月牙铜角盔、兽首铜肩、胸口裂开的铜护心镜、红战旗 + 腰后红披、大剑带红穗；同版式带正 / 背 / 侧、头部特写、大剑和剑首、三个出招动作、色板。和提示词有出入的地方：盔下是带橙眼缝的面甲（提示词要魔面、不要面甲）；背后没画剑鞘；画面带了火焰剑光和地面火光（只在出招小图和背景）。
